title: Reading Drill — Deciding where to store sandbags — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Deciding where to store sandbags — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The local planning team in Bramley received an old report about bags being collected too far from likely flood sites. The report compared round-trip time to collect supplies, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the trial journeys rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered ten weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include journeys during heavy traffic. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed smaller depots near streams as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
